name: GalaxyCon Nashville
blurb: A three-day Nashville festival of fandom from GalaxyCon, debuting with celebrities, comic creators, wrestlers and fan groups at The Fairgrounds Nashville.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'GALAXYCON NASHVILLE ... June 4-6, 2027'; LOCATION text: 'The Fairgrounds Nashville 401 Wingrove St. Nashville TN 37203'

notes: This is a new 2027 debut city (per the discovery note), confirmed directly from the live site. Thirteen cards on the Nashville guests page (#5-16, #22; Diane Pershing, Loren Lester, Bob West, Jeff Steitzer, John DiMaggio, Roger Craig Smith, Charles Martinet, Sam Witwer, Kenn Scott, Brian Tochi, Robbie Rist, Ernie Reyes Jr., and a duplicate Joe Wos) are each captioned 'at GalaxyCon Columbus', not Nashville — leftover/mistemplated data, not a Nashville confirmation — so none of them are picked; Joe Wos is still counted once from his correctly Nashville-captioned card (#29). #31 compounds this with a concatenated 'GamingComing SoonTabitha Lyons at GalaxyCon Columbus' caption and is excluded outright. #30 'FSCW' is the same unexplained acronym seen on galaxycon-columbus (filename even disagrees with the caption, 'FCSW' vs 'FSCW') and is left out rather than guessed. #44-45 (JSA, Agents of Slabs) are Authentication vendor services, excluded. Known for is left blank throughout (no bio text on any card). Cover uses the Nashville wordmark logo; the homepage's other images are the shared 11-city promo, decorative props, stock photos and a ticket-sale banner.
